name: devskillslearning-pipeline
description: Complete AI-first Java/Spring Boot SDLC automation — 18 skills: scaffold, write-code, code-review, write-tests, refactor, diagnose, secure, deploy, document, migrate, github, monitor, design-api, database, resilience, perf-test, release, dependency. Covers REST, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket, reactive, Spring Modulith, event-driven, batch, multi-tenancy. Full enterprise stack: OAuth2/JWT, K8s, CI/CD, Problem Details (RFC 7807), WireMock, test slices, read replicas. Production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards. Contract-first API design: OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, gRPC, GraphQL. Database: schema design, query optimization, no-downtime migrations. Resilience: circuit breaker, retry, timeout, bulkhead, rate limiter. Performance: k6/Gatling load tests, JFR/profiling, capacity planning. Release management: semantic versioning, changelogs, release notes. Dependency management: OWASP scanning, version catalogs, BOMs, Renovate/Dependabot. GitHub integration: create epics/stories/tickets, PR review by URL or ticket ID, issue management via MCP.
